project_type: Full-stack Next.js 14 App Router application with serverless backend
test_framework: Vitest for unit/integration tests, Playwright for E2E (optional later)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm install to install deps. 2. Run pnpm build to verify TypeScript compilation and Next.js build. 3. Run pnpm test to run unit tests. 4. Run pnpm lint to check code quality.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Prisma client is generated from schema via `pnpm prisma generate`. No checked-in snapshots.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/copy-trading. 2. pnpm install. 3. Copy .env.example to .env.local and fill in values. 4. pnpm prisma generate. 5. pnpm dev to run locally.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - can install packages from registries. Node.js v22 available. No database server running locally - use mock/in-memory for tests. No Docker daemon assumed available.
contribution_requirements: Greenfield project - establishing conventions. Use conventional commits. TypeScript strict mode. ESLint + Prettier for formatting.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with server components by default. API routes in app/api/. Prisma for DB access. NextAuth for authentication. shadcn/ui components in components/ui/. Feature-based organization under src/. Tradovate adapter pattern for multi-platform support.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages and API routes. src/components/ - React components (ui/ for shadcn, shared/ for reusable). src/lib/ - Business logic, utilities, database client. src/lib/trading/ - Trading platform adapters. prisma/ - Database schema and migrations. public/ - Static assets.
